com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:read consent. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only; no prices, strategy, enrollment or export jobs change.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Invalid selections/cursors or unowned integrations fail; unsuitable guidance, checkout holds and sale-priced copies are skipped.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: Use prepare_card_price_updates for exact custom prices or in-chat approvals. This read does not grant write approval or configure recurring repricing.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Preview one-time price changes for the connected store's RAW, graded or all cards.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns current/market/proposed prices, market timestamp/usability, any cached lowest eBay catalog ask, skipped reasons, nextCursor and a website review URL, without approval tokens. Catalog asks are not live or grade-matched sold comps.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use when researching current, market and cached lowest asking prices, or comparing strategy proposals before website approval. An omitted strategy uses the store setting.

automationMode.description: Prepare OFF, recommendations, or automatically applied ongoing repricing. Does not change settings until confirmed in SuperCatch.

cardType.description: Review RAW, graded/authenticated, or all active in-stock card copies in the connected store.

cursor.description: Continue with nextCursor from the previous page, keeping the same selection.

direction.description: Filter one-time price changes. Ongoing repricing requires ANY; publishing includes all displayed cards.

integrationId.description: Choose an enabled connection ID returned in publishing.targets for this store. The seller confirms the exact account before a normal export job is queued.

strategy.description: AT_MARKET, PREMIUM (above market), or MOVE_FAST. Omit to use the existing store strategy. Confirmed automation uses this as store-wide strategy.
